title: WPSB/344/2021 of VIMLESH DIMRI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

The Court made the following:
JUDGEMENT: (per Hon'ble Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari)

According to the petitioner, in the year 2012 he
was engaged as teacher by respondent no.2 through
Uttarakhand Purvsainik Kalyan Nigam Limited-respondent
no.4 and he served in the campus college of University at
Dehradun upto the year 2016. Subsequently, he was
transferred to a private college affiliated to Uttarakhand
Technical University situated at Tanakpur vide order dated
20.10.2016, as modified vide order dated 02.11.2016.
According to petitioner, he was not permitted to join at the
transferred place and subsequently the said order was set
aside by the State Government on 01.06.2017. Grievance
of the petitioner is that since 02.11.2016, he has not been
paid any salary and no work has also been assigned to him.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn
attention of this Court to a document enclosed as
Annexure-6 to the writ petition. Perusal of the said
document indicates that the Vice Chancellor, Uttarakhand
Technical University had constituted a committee vide order
dated 19.01.2018 which was headed by Registrar of the
University. It is the case of the petitioner that the
committee has not submitted its report as yet and due to
pendency of enquiry, petitioner is neither being permitted
by the University to discharge duties nor his name is being
2

sponsored by the Respondent No.4. Learned counsel for the
petitioner confined his prayer only to the extent that the
enquiry committee be directed to submit its report at the
earliest.
3. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of
the case, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to
the Registrar, Uttarakhand Technical University to take all
necessary steps for ensuring that the Committee
constituted vide order dated 19.01.2019 submits its report,
as early as possible; but, not later than six weeks' from the
date of production of certified copy of this order.
